# Polyfills across the dialects

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_polyfill_docs.py from provisa/transpiler/polyfill: do not edit by hand. -->

Each PostgreSQL feature of the polyfill grid on each connector dialect Provisa sends SQL to, a serving engine's or a source's a statement is sent to directly: **native** (it answers as PostgreSQL does, with no polyfill), **polyfilled** (Provisa supplies PostgreSQL's behaviour, with no difference), **differs** (polyfilled, with a limitation), **refused** (a client receives the refusal its row states). The polyfills and limitations of each dialect are on its page: [PostgreSQL](postgres.md), [DuckDB](duckdb.md), [Trino](trino.md), [Presto](presto.md), [Athena](athena.md), [ClickHouse](clickhouse.md), [Snowflake](snowflake.md), [Databricks](databricks.md), [BigQuery](bigquery.md), [T-SQL (SQL Server, Fabric, Synapse)](tsql.md), [Redshift](redshift.md), [MySQL](mysql.md), [SingleStore](singlestore.md), [SQLite](sqlite.md), [Oracle](oracle.md), [Hive](hive.md), [Exasol](exasol.md), [Druid](druid.md).
